title: Software
description: The vocabulary of a software island: products and their features, bugs, releases, repositories, commits, and the running system. Built on the shared set alone, for an island map; beside it the software pack serves a map without islands.

types.title: Product
types.description: What is built and shipped: the hub its features and bugs are part of, living in its repository. Its roadmap is its features in order.

types.title: Feature
types.description: A capability of a product, part of it, ordered on its roadmap; the tasks that build it are part of it. Built means merged but not yet in a release.

order.description: Position on the roadmap among its siblings. Lower comes first.

tokens_estimated.description: How many tokens an agent expects this to take in all, one number: input and output together, not counting cached re-reads. It stands only while none of the tasks that are part of it has an estimate.

tokens_used.description: Tokens spent on it directly, measured from the sessions that worked on it.

types.title: Bug
types.description: Something wrong in a product: a defect, or friction someone met using it. Part of the product or feature it is in; the work that fixes it is linked by fixes.

repro.description: How to make it happen again.

types.title: Release
types.description: A version shipped or planned, and its gate: it depends_on what it waits for, ships what goes out in it and defers what follows after.

at.description: When it went out, or is to.

types.title: Repository
types.description: A source repository: where a product's work lives (lives_in), found by its remote.

types.title: Commit
types.description: A commit accounted for: it lives in its repository and says which items it settles, each by a settles link, and none when it has none.

sha.description: The commit's full id (40 hex characters).

accounted.description: false while the commit was only heard of and nobody has said what it settles; true, or left out, once someone has.

types.title: Component
types.description: A part of a running system: a service, a store, a proxy, a client. Part of the environment it runs in; it calls what it sends to. Its status is its health; standby is built but stopped on purpose.

role.description: What it does in the system.

host.description: Where it runs, as its operator names it: a container, a machine, a region.

url.description: The address its health is read from.

types.title: Part
types.description: A part of a mechanism: a rule, a hook, a tool, a step of how something works. Its status says whether it does its job; what runs and is watched is a component. Part of what it belongs to; it calls what it hands on to.

role.description: What it does in the mechanism, as a component's role.

types.title: Environment
types.description: Somewhere software runs: a machine, staging, production. Its components are part of it.

links.title: settles
links.description: The commit finished or changed this item: a task it did, a bug it fixed, a decision it carried out.

links.title: fixes
links.description: Work meant to fix the bug. Closing the work offers to close the bug.

links.title: calls
links.description: A wire of a running system: the one part sends to the other (a request, a query, a backup). It blocks nothing. props.says names how (HTTPS, SQL).

views.title: Roadmap
views.description: A product's features in the order they are to be built, the work under each, and where work is happening now.
Heard of, and nobody has said what it settles: account for it with its settles links, and accounted true.

styles.title: Tend the software island
styles.body: On a software island, a feature is part of its product and moves planned, building, built (merged), shipped (in a release). The tasks that build it are part of it, and what one waits for is depends_on. Something wrong is a bug, part of what it is in, and the work that fixes it is linked to it by fixes. A release depends_on what it waits for, ships what goes out in it and defers what follows. A product and its work live_in their repository.

styles.title: Account for each commit
styles.body: Every commit you make is put on the map in the same change as what it settles: a commit (its full sha) living in its repository, and a settles link to each item it finished or changed, or none. A commit heard of that nobody accounted for is made with accounted false; accounting for it is setting accounted true, with its links.
